Welcome to Voat Cancer.

The information below is a WIP, I welcome criticism and ideas.

What is this place?: The goal of /v/VoatCancer is to be a watchdog group for abusive Mods/Admin. The hope is that people can get together and discuss possible problems with Mods and Admins and hopefully solving them.

The goal of this sub is NOT to fling shit at Mods/Admins. I want to be able to have a third party sub to come and discuss accusations with a goal of coming up with solutions. Please do not just downvote the accused to oblivion. Hopefully everyone comes away happy and the Voat community is better for it.

I understand that some issued won't be solved here but I think it's worth the effort.

/v/VoatCancer Rules:

Please read all the rules. Claiming not knowing the rules will not be an acceptable excuse.

  1. General Voat Rules apply.
  2. Be civil.
  3. Trolling and baiting is not welcome.
  4. Do not brigade subs/mods/admins being accused.
  5. Do not brigade accuser.

Submission formatting and guidelines:

Before you write a report, please make sure this isn't something petty or something that can't be resolved by discussing the problem with the Mod/Admin in question or with other Mods from the sub.

Please be as thorough as possible. Screenshots of discussions would be useful in seeing the big picture. DO NOT edit conversations to skew the discussion in your favor or to slander a Mod/Admin. This will get you banned.

Formating:

Mod/Admins name:
Sub where altercation happened:
Description of events:
Screenshots(if applicable):
How can the issue be resolved(in your opinion):

Feel free to add more information if relevant but please follow the formatting as much as possible.

Mod/Admin Defense

Mods and Admins accused are welcome and encouraged to give there side of the story. Please address the accusers points directly(ex: rules broken, why they were banned, why post was deleted, etc). Screenshots of are welcome if you believe the accuser falsified or didn't show the whole discussion.

Job Openings:

/v/VoatCancer will be in need of Mods once we start getting traffic. Keep an eye out for openings.

I am still learning about this one. I picked it up from a guy down in the city ... he had it listed for $3000 but when I test drove it I only made it about 1,000' before it just shit on itself. I wound up offering the guy $2000 for it and he bit. Through the wonders of the web, youtube, reddit, and forums I was able to get an idea of what is going on. Gotta have air, fuel and spark ... best thing for me to do was to replace everything that controlled those functions. I am almost done with converting it from the 4bbl carb it came with to a rebuilt GM TBI setup. I installed an Edlebrock Performer RPM intake and Headmann Headers so now air flow is resolved.
